code: stb_image does not reject fractional JPEG component subsampling ratios.
note: The vulnerability hypothesis is that crafted JPEG metadata can drive unsupported resampling ratios into the decoder.
The JPEG SOF header supplies per-component horizontal and vertical sampling factors.
The decoder allocates component buffers based on the declared sampling factors, so malformed ratios propagate into later resampling state.
During JPEG load, the code derives the horizontal upsampling ratio from the header-controlled sampling factors.
The vertical upsampling ratio is derived the same way and can become a non-1/2 value for crafted component layouts.

code: if      (r->hs == 1 && r->vs == 1) ... else if ... else r->resample = stbi__resample_row_generic;
note: Before the fix, unsupported ratios fell through to the generic resampler instead of being rejected.

code: for (i=0; i < w; ++i) for (j=0; j < hs; ++j) out[i*hs+j] = in_near[i];
note: The generic resampler assumes integer expansion factors and writes using hs as a repeat count, which is unsafe for fractional JPEG subsampling ratios.
